name: Counter surveillance
description: The adversary is implementing measures against surveillance.

subtechniques.name: Avoid using Tor/VPN to access services on the same ASN
subtechniques.description: To make correlations harder, avoid using services from the same ISP or ASN.

procedures.name: Magic blanket
procedures.description: A magic blanket is a small blanket which could be used to mitigate visual surveillance and prevent shoulder surfing in public and private places.

procedures.name: ObscuraCam
procedures.description: Obscuracam can blur and disguise faces in photos and videos. https://guardianproject.info/apps/org.witness.sscphase1/

procedures.name: Reflectacles.com
procedures.description: Reflectacles are glasses that are designed to fool facial recognition systems that use infrared for illumination and systems using 3D infrared mapping/scanning. https://www.reflectacles.com/

procedures.name: Shielding paint
procedures.description: Shielding paint is special paint for shielding of electromagnetic fields to prevent side-channel attacks.
